pie.es:

pie.en:
Please ask about other gluten-free options.
**If you have any dietary restrictions, please inform your waiter before placing your order.** 

May contain one or more of the following allergens:
1 | Celery
2 | Gluten
3 | Crustaceans
4 | Eggs
5 | Fish
6 | Lupin flour
7 | Molluscs
8 | Mustard
9 | Nuts
10 | Peanuts
11 | Sesame seeds
12 | Soy
13 | Sulfur dioxide
